I replied to Pree in the #central-team thread to say I'd noted it. I also asked which year they meant, because the simulation date is 14 October 2026, so 25 August 2026 has already passed. If they meant 25 August 2027, or some other date, they can confirm in the thread.

Nothing else was needed. The brain saves their channel message automatically. I searched it and found no other record of a Tansley Parcel order-form deadline, so nothing conflicts with what Pree said. The search ran in keyword-only mode, though, so it may have missed records that use different wording.
